basic_details.job_title: District Court Wayanad Confidential Assistant Grade II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.application_mode: Offline (In person or by post / Email)

age_limit.details: Applicants should not have completed 62 years of age.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | confidential assistant grade-ii: Applicants must have retired from the Judicial Department in the same post (Confidential Assistant Grade-II). In the absence of qualified persons from the same category, persons retired from a corresponding post in other departments will be considered.

salary_details.pay_scale: As per rules (equivalent to the post retired from)
salary_details.confidential assistant grade-ii: Equal to the last drawn salary in the same post from which the applicant retired from the Judicial Department, in accordance with the terms of the Kerala Service Rules Part I, Appendix 1 and government order G.O.(P) No.24/2026/Fin dated 18.02.2026.
salary_details.details: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or special benefits beyond the established rules for retired personnel re-engaged on contract basis.

selection_process: The selection process consists of application screening and the execution of an agreement between the selected candidate and the Government.

Applicants must have retired from the Judicial Department. Other department retirees will only be considered if Judicial Department applicants are unavailable. Candidates who have completed 62 years of age are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Prepare a complete biodata along with self-attested copies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications, and work experience.
Ensure the certificates are duly attested by a gazetted officer or authority as indicated in the notification.
Write "താത്കാലിക നിയമനത്തിനുള്ള അപേക്ഷ" clearly on top of the envelope.
Submit the application either in person or send it by post to the District Judge, District Court Kalpetta, Wayanad - 673 122.
Alternatively, clear applications can also be sent via email to [email protected].
Ensure that the application reaches the office on or before 13.10.2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the fixed time will not be considered.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the designated address or email by 13.10.2026 at 5:00 PM. Late submissions or applications received after the specified time will be summarily rejected. The envelope containing the application must explicitly state "താത്കാലിക നിയമനത്തിനുള്ള അപേക്ഷ". The engagement is purely on a contract basis for 179 days or until a regular appointee joins duty, whichever is earlier. Service conditions and service agreements are governed by Kerala Service Rules Part I, Appendix 1 and G.O.(P) No.24/2026/Fin dated 18.02.2026.
